takeaway: AI-powered Diffusion models start with pure visual static and gradually remove noise over many steps, revealing a perfect image from chaos!
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

AI can paint astonishing images starting from nothing but random TV static!

Here is the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 AI Diffusion models begin with 100% pure visual noise.
🔹 They 'denoise' this static over around 50 precise steps.
🔹 Each step subtly removes noise, revealing a clear image, like cleaning a window!
